title: JMeter vs k6 — Runnable Payment Flow Scripts
title_es: JMeter vs k6 — Scripts Ejecutables del Flujo de Pagos
description: The runnable artifacts from the JMeter vs k6 decision guide: a k6 v1.x payments script with thresholds and think time, a JMeter 5.6.3 JSR223 Groovy sampler, both GitHub Actions workflows and the JTL assertion script.
description_es: Los artefactos ejecutables de la guía JMeter vs k6: un script de pagos de k6 v1.x con thresholds y think time, un sampler JSR223 Groovy de JMeter 5.6.3, los dos workflows de GitHub Actions y el script de aserción de JTL.
